Name: Warp Network
Author: tlitookilakin
Description:
[u][b]Installation[/b][/u]

Warp Network is installed like any other SMAPI mod- simply unzip it and drop it into the "Stardew Valley/Mods" folder. Make sure to also install the correct version of SMAPI!

[u][b]Usage[/b][/u]

The warp network can be accessed by right-clicking on any of the warp statues in the world, or by using the return scepter (when enabled via config.) This mod also fixes some vanilla bugs related to teleportation. Content pack makers can also use it to add custom warp totems or modify the existing ones. (See github wiki for details)

[u][b]Configuration[/b][/u]

Warp Network can be configured either in-game (if Generic Mod Config Menu is also installed), or by directly editing the "config.json" file in the Warp Network mod folder. (Note: you need to run the game with the mod loaded [b]at least once[/b] before the config file will appear.)
For a list of config options and a description of what they do, please visit the [url=https://github.com/tlitookilakin/WarpNetwork/wiki/Configuration]wiki [/url]page.

[u][b]Customizing/Modding Warp Network[/b][/u]

Please visit the [url=https://github.com/tlitookilakin/WarpNetwork/wiki]wiki [/url]on the [url=https://github.com/tlitookilakin/WarpNetwork]github [/url]for details.

[u][b]Known Issues[/b][/u]

* Adding the "WarpNetworkEntry" property to one of the vanilla warp locations (Mountain, Farm, Beach, Desert, Ginger Island) using"EditMap" will not prevent the warp network from creating an access point at the normal warp position. (Use it with Load, or edit the destination data to match.)
* Warping into a festival (or other event) will always place the player at the usual starting/entry position. Due to the way events and festivals work, this will not be fixed.

[u][b]Compatibility[/b][/u]

No known incompatibilities.

[u][b]Troubleshooting[/b][/u]

When reporting a bug, please follow these steps:
[list=1]
[*]Fully launch the game, then get to the part where the problem occurs.
[*]If this does not crash the game, type "warpnet debug" into console. if the game crashed, skip this step.
[*]If the game is still open at this point, close it.
[*]Upload a log [url=https://smapi.io/log]here[/url], following the instructions on the page.
[*]Post a bug in the issue tracker, including a link to your uploaded log, and a [b]detailed[/b] description of the bug.

[/list]It is also recommended to look for help on the "using-mods" channel on the SDV discord, but not required.

[center][u][b]THIS MOD MAY NOT BE UPLOADED ANYWHERE OTHER THAN NEXUS AND MODDROP[/b][/u][/center]
